SELECT 
  AVG(avg_net_fee) as avg_of_abovebenchmark_pairs,
  AVG(avg_net_fee - 0.0005188614956742864) as avg_excess_over_benchmark
FROM (
  SELECT AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) as avg_net_fee 
  FROM fees f 
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault 
  GROUP BY o.mktnote 
  HAVING AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) > 0.0005188614956742864
)
